draft.description: Draft order: secondary badge, no tags.

paid.description: Paid order: default (neutral) status badge (Recently Paid and Consolidated use the same variant).

cancelled.description: Cancelled / returned order: destructive Return badge (the card has no separate "cancelled" status; Return is the destructive one in getBadgeVariant).

print-warning.description: Print warning: red-outline tag with the elapsed time beside the status badge (custom_invoice_warning_time exceeded).

split.description: Split bill: tagAccent "Split n of m" tag, 4px primary-500 start border and the primary-700 "Split from" note.

merged.description: Merged bill: "Merged Bill" tag, 4px primary-500 start border, primary-700 "Includes" note and the combined total.

selected.description: Selected card: ring-2 blue-500 plus shadow-lg.

disabled.reason: not applicable: this component has no distinct disabled variant
